'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Martin den Boef LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Martin den Boef]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Martin den Boef]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
